title: Master's battery percentage on follower watch face
body:
Hello,

My son has T1D and his phone is a master for followers. My phone is a follower and works with my watch. Everything works fine except one thing: my watch shows my phone's battery (follower's battery in the 'Uploader %' field) but not the master's battery (as I think should be). Please advise what I missed in the settings or add this as an issue.

Thank you
